title: GUI Project Detail Auto Update - Rework 1
outcome_summary: This project reworked the GUI project-detail view and its test suite across 4 work packages: consolidating 6 diverged fixture helpers into a shared makeProject() factory, removing dead code and inline DOM writes from project-detail.js, and extracting renderRunsList and _findScrollAnchor into module-level testable functions with 9 new unit tests. All 16 pipeline stages passed with zero reworks, growing the test suite from 3205 to 3214 tests with zero failures.
